title: Spam Musubi (Sample)
description: Sample recipe for demonstration only. A savory grilled Spam and rice snack wrapped with nori.

ingredients.name: water, or amount listed on rice package

instructions: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear. Cook with the water according to the package directions, then let it rest for 5 minutes and fluff.
Stir together the soy sauce, sugar, and mirin until the sugar dissolves.
Pan-fry the Spam slices over medium heat until browned on both sides. Pour in the sauce and turn the slices until glazed; remove from the heat.
With damp hands or a musubi mold, press the warm rice into 8 compact rectangles.
Place a glazed Spam slice on each rice block and wrap a strip of nori around it. Serve warm.
notes: This clearly labeled sample is for demonstration only; the bundled cartoon is an illustration, not a food photo.
